{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Count how many QA orders are in the 'completed' group
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = len(df[df['status'] == 'completed'])

# Actual completed orders (excluding QA)
actual_completed = total_completed - len(qa_completed)

# Print the final answer
print(f"Actual completed orders (excluding QA): {actual_completed}")"}
